content: Rules Q&A assistants (RulesBot.ai, Boardside, BGRB, Ludomentor, Geek AI) are RAG-style chatbots grounded in official rulebooks/FAQs/errata, returning answers with citations to rulebook page/section, scoped per-game (select game first), often with a 'sources used' transparency element to build trust vs. hallucination risk. Common features: per-game chat, citation of exact rule passage, disambiguation when a rule is edition-specific, and no general open-ended Q&A outside the selected game's ruleset.
